methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops led by a Norfolk native represent grassroots, peer-driven capacity building outside traditional tech hubs—a direct signal of distributed deep learning emerging through community networks rather than institutional infrastructure.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - roanoke.edu
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab establishment in a non-metro region signals institutional commitment to developing deep AI capability beyond NoVA, creating potential peer learning networks that could distribute expertise through professional education.

signals.title: AI in Roanoke County schools: How new policies will guide student use - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: School policy development around student AI use suggests shallow, consumption-oriented adoption where AI tools are regulated rather than deeply understood—widespread access without capability depth across rural Virginia districts.

signals.title: After severe 76% electricity price hikes due to AI data centers, Virginia requires firms to pay for all dedicated upstream electrical infrastructure — state regulators crack down, governor says move will save civilians ‘hundreds of millions of dollars’ - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Electricity price hikes from data center concentration reveal how infrastructure costs fall on civilians while AI capability remains locked in corporate facilities—economic burden distributed, but capability highly concentrated, accelerating resentment without participation.

signals.title: Fairfax Teen Builds Free AI Tool To Help Neurodivergent Job Seekers - Patch
signals.signal_reading: A Fairfax teen building sophisticated AI accessibility tools demonstrates the deep technical talent emerging from NoVA's resource-rich environment, reinforcing metropolitan concentration of capability even in youth innovation ecosystems.
